hooks.prompt: You just exited plan mode. If there is an active Syntaur assignment (check for a workspace field in assignment.md), pick the next unused `plan-v<N>.md` filename (or `plan.md` if no plan*.md exists yet) under the assignment dir and write the plan you just created there.

Before compaction, if there is an active Syntaur assignment (check `.syntaur/context.json` for `assignmentDir`), invoke `/save-session-summary` so a future session can resume cleanly. The summary is written under `<assignmentDir>/sessions/<sessionId>/`, where the CLI resolves `<sessionId>` from your running process (env / process tree) — do not read it from the `context.json` scalar (a co-tenant can clobber that hint). Skip silently if no active Syntaur context. Do NOT write to `handoff.md` — that is reserved for cross-ticket handoff at completion.
